Package org.cyclops.integratedterminals.client.gui.container.component

Class GuiCraftingPlanHeader

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.integratedterminals.client.gui.container.component.GuiCraftingPlanHeader
public class GuiCraftingPlanHeader extends Object
The header lines above a crafting plan view: label, durations, channel and initiator. It is shared by all crafting plan views.
